map.text: This is Timmy — a terminal AI agent that writes a receipt for everything it does.
Every prompt, every command, every action — hashed, signed, and chained.
Other agents ask for your trust. Timmy hands you proof.
on_screen: diff card: - trust me / + verify me

map.text: Every box went into the record before the wrap ever came off — the ones we bought, and the one Fanatics sent us, letter and all.
By the time the first pack was opened, the proof already existed.
You don't have to trust any of it,
because you can check all of it.
And when a bad record showed up, Timmy didn't argue — it refused.
It was never about cards. Any agent, any workflow — if it acted, there's a receipt.
Code it, browse it, render it — Timmy proves every move. If you use or build AI agents, Timmy keeps them honest. Live and die by the receipts.
